header.generator: ts-fsrs v5.4.2 using FSRS-6.0 from npm, run outside this repository
header.inputs: Each history starts from createEmptyCard with card_id set to cardId; every review is at 00:00Z of its day, so a DayKey difference equals ts-fsrs's elapsed days. Each step is scheduler.repeat(card, day); preview holds the again, hard and good outcomes, and the card goes on with the step's grade. Retrievability rows are scheduler.forgetting_curve(elapsedDays, stability).
header.reproduce: npm install ts-fsrs@5.4.2, then run the script below with node

script: // Prints golden vectors for instant-composition's FSRS-6 domain rules, as JSON.
// Run with `node generate.mjs > fsrs-golden.json` beside `npm install ts-fsrs@5.4.2`.
const GRADES = { again: Rating.Again, hard: Rating.Hard, good: Rating.Good };
// `steps` is a list of [days after the previous review, grade]; the first
out.push({ day: dayKey(at), grade, preview: shown });
// A fixed linear congruential generator, so the inputs below are the same on
// every run; the inputs are also written out in full in the fixture.
// Example 2: ten cards graded good on 2026-10-01 and again on their due day.
// Hand-picked paths: lapses, early and late reviews, the 365-day cap.
// Generated paths: a random grade each time, reviewed from a day after the
// previous review to well past its due day.
